name: GPU Undervolt & Overclock Studio (no Afterburner needed)
author: OpenRevo Official & Community
description: Official sample plugin: a native NVIDIA GPU tuning center without installing MSI Afterburner. Based on a direct system-level nvapi64.dll driver link, it supports transparent core/memory overclocking, live 127-anchor V/F curve parsing, one-click shifted undervolting and a crash-safe guard, with all tuning maintained at the driver hardware level.
